entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The land whose creatures and cultures stood together against a threat; beyond it lies danger and promise.

entities.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
entities.description: A vast creature whose wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

entities.name: Claire
entities.description: A batfolk astrologer whose night of research was spoiled.

entities.name: Lily Emberseed
entities.description: A figure of renown, once known as Lily of Valley, said to have drunk from a collector's mug.

entities.name: Root Maze
entities.description: A maze with no path to its center.

entities.name: Alania, Divergent Storm
entities.description: A storm-associated figure who refuses to chase the storm, likening herself to a cloud or the sun.

entities.name: Hugs, Grisly Guardian
entities.description: A scarred guardian whose scars tell tales and a few jokes.

entities.name: Rotcallers
entities.description: A group with the saying that all share one life and one death.

events.summary: Every creature and culture of Valley stood in unison against a threat despite their differences.
events.quote: Despite their differences, every creature and culture of Valley stood in unison against the threat.

events.summary: Claire's night of research is spoiled.
events.quote: "Well, that's another night of research spoiled."

relations.note: Formerly known as Lily of Valley
relations.quote: They say Lily Emberseed herself drank from this mug when she was still Lily of Valley.
